fix04_required_outcome: Run the exact local barrier validator, or equivalent production logic, on every accepted ConditionalGate contact.
Resolve each unsupported contact by reroute, a legitimate global join, permanent solid separation, or an exact typed local boundary; never by remote gate membership.
Evaluate the physical movement graph crossed with every reachable logical FSM state and every connection whose canonical predicate is open.
Preserve all six resource orders, required approach/return paths and normal recovery while all closed gates are applied simultaneously.
Reject candidate global cut faces that break any required currently-open transition; include combined-gate collateral fixtures.
Export local_barrier_checks.json and physical_transition_matrix.json from the accepted plan.
